_doc: Per-series Kalshi settlement rules harvested VERBATIM from GET /series/{ticker} product_metadata.important_info on the discovery snapshot; the classification fields (no_ball_rule, retirement_rule) are derived from that text and must be re-verified whenever important_info_id changes (health gate TENNIS-9 compares ids). Series without important_info are UNKNOWN and their non-binary settlements are handled only through observed exchange truth.

KXATPACES.important_info_markdown: **Important information:** If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If a retirement occurs, all markets will resolve based on the statistics officially completed and recorded prior to the cancellation or discontinuation of the match.

KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH.important_info_markdown: **Important information:** If the match does not start (signaled by a ball being played), the market will resolve to a fair price for each player in accordance with the rules. If a player withdraws or forfeits after a match has started, that player will resolve to no.

KXATPEXACTMATCH.important_info_markdown: **Important information:** If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. Any markets that cannot be unconditionally settled will resolve to Fair Market Price.

KXATPMATCH.important_info_markdown: **Important information**: If the match does not begin (signaled by a ball being played), all markets, including set winner markets, will resolve to a **fair price** for each player in accordance with the rules. If a player withdraws or forfeits after the match has begun, that player will resolve to **No** for the main match market. Any markets that can be definitively determined at that point will be settled accordingly, while any additional prop markets will resolve to a **fair price**.
